_docs_es.fuentes: Redis en vivo (metricas del ultimo latido por nodo) y Postgres en historico; el heartbeat porta rss_kib, streams, loss_estimate y ver via hbcodec (BLUEPRINT §12). El nodo no expone puerto de scraping: todo entra por el tunel.
_docs_es.alerta_rss: El panel RSS p99 lleva alerta configurada a 6 MB (techo del SLO §12); fleet.json versiona el umbral para que el cambio sea PR, no clic de UI.
_docs_es.frescura: Inventario de versiones: el ver del latido debe coincidir con nodes.agent_version en < 1 heartbeat; una desviacion > 0 es inventario rancio, no latido perdido.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rss_kib)/1024.0 AS rss_p99_mib FROM node_heartbeats WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

alert.title: RSS p99 sobre el techo del SLO

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY loss_estimate) AS loss_p99_bp FROM node_heartbeats WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT n.agent_version AS ver, count(*) AS nodos, max(h.last_heartbeat) AS ultimo_latido, bool_and(h.last_agent_ver = n.agent_version) AS inventario_fresco FROM nodes n JOIN LATERAL (SELECT agent_version AS last_agent_ver, ts AS last_heartbeat FROM node_heartbeats h2 WHERE h2.node_id = n.node_id ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) h ON true GROUP BY n.agent_version ORDER BY nodos DESC
